title: Test suite: 8 flash tests silently pass when setup fails
description: test_flash_pkcs11_login_correct_pin and 7 sibling tests return 0 (zero failures) when flash_test_make_keystore() fails. The actual test code never runs. A broken RNG, keygen, or keystore path causes the entire test category to report 'no failures'. The test driver cannot distinguish 'setup failed, nothing tested' from 'tested and passed'.
